text:
Maya: Heads-up — found a half-full jar of kombucha in the pods fridge labelled "For the shrine" :eyes:
Devin: Wait what shrine? I only know about the snack altar and the quiet lamp :joy:
Sidd: The kombucha shrine is very much real. It started when someone left a fermenting tea and a Post-it that said "Offerings welcome" :tropical_drink:
Jules: I added a tiny origami boat to it yesterday. Felt wrong and right at the same time :sailboat:
Riley: We should probably make this official. Nominate a Kombucha Steward? Responsibilities: defend jar, rotate stock, and perform weekly opening chant (optional) :raised_hands:
Devin: I nominate Maya because she buys weird probiotics anyway :grin:
Maya: I'll accept if duties include tasting on Fridays and veto power over mystery flavors :ok_hand:
Sidd: Voting poll: add Maya as steward, or start rotational rota. React with :thumbsup: for Maya, :white_check_mark: for rota, :laughing: for "trap the fermenter" plan.
Jules: Poll result so far: two :thumbsup:, one :white_check_mark:, one :laughing:. Tossing in the weekend duty matrix in case of emergency.
Riley: OpsBot, set a recurring "Kombucha Shrine Check" every Monday at 10am and ping #random.
OpsBot: Scheduled: "Kombucha Shrine Check" — Mondays 10:00am — Reminder set to channel #random. See /reminders for details.
Devin: Also can we establish "no mystery jars" rule. If you leave something, put a note with date and name. Last mystery jar was a tragedy.
Maya: Agreed. Sign-up snippet I made if we want to be nerdy about it:

Mon - Maya
Tue - Devin
Wed - Sidd
Thu - Jules
Fri - Weekend team (rotate)

Sidd: Love the nerdy rota. Can we add a tiny emoji next to each name? Makes the shrine more friendly :sparkles:
Jules: Adding a tiny paper boat emoji next to mine, obviously.
Riley: Also proposing we add a small laminated sign: "Offerings accepted. Please label. No mystery funk."
Devin: If we ever turn this into merch I call dibs on a Kombucha Steward hoodie.
Maya: Dibs on the patch. Also — anyone allergic to SCOBYs, please step forward now.
Jules: Not allergic, just deeply suspicious.
Riley: Closing note: thanks to whoever started this. The shrine makes the office feel delightfully uncanny and slightly fermented :heart:
Maya: Okay steward duties accepted. First task: Remove ancient bottle from fridge and conduct ceremonial sniff test on Friday 3pm. Volunteers?
Devin: I'll be there. If I don't return, tell my plants I love them. :cry:
Sidd: I will film for posterity (and evidence). :video_camera:
Jules: I brought a tiny flag for the shrine. See you Friday. :spiral_calendar:
